observations: Three photos show a disassembled engine block with cylinder head removed, exposing four cylinder bores.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder inline engine, with visible intake manifold, valve covers, and part of the oil pan.
The component is dirty and shows signs of use, with some rust and grime on the metal surfaces.
A watermark 'KING SOLOMON AUTO' is visible on all photos.
A person's feet in blue Adidas-style sneakers are visible in the background of all photos.
No visible branding, model tags, or VIN numbers on the engine block itself.
The engine is not complete — missing crankshaft, pistons, connecting rods, and other major components.
